description: This file contains the implementation of a configuration class for GitHub Copilot's Responses API. It defines methods for setting up headers, validating environment settings, forming the API URL, and handling reasoning items to maintain encrypted content. It leverages authentication, manages headers, and includes utilities for vision content detection.

classes.name: GithubCopilotResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: A configuration class derived from OpenAIResponsesAPIConfig, tailored for GitHub Copilot's Responses API. It manages environment validation, header setup, URL formation, and specific logic for handling reasoning items and input analysis relevant to Copilot's API.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the config with an Authenticator instance.

methods.name: LlmProviders custom_llm_provider(self)
methods.description: Returns the provider identifier for GitHub Copilot.

methods.name: list get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported OpenAI API parameters.

methods.name: Dict map_openai_params( self, response_api_optional_params: ResponsesAPIOptionalRequestParams, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and returns response API parameters with no modification.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams], )
methods.description: Obtains API key via OAuth, sets headers (merging default and user headers), and adds special headers based on input analysis, including handling vision requests.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], litellm_params: dict, )
methods.description: Constructs and returns the full URL for the Responses API endpoint, based on provided or default API base.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _handle_reasoning_item(self, item: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Preserves encrypted_content in reasoning items while filtering out status=None, addressing a specific Copilot API requirement.

methods.name: Optional[Union[str,ResponseInputParam]] _get_input_from_params( self, litellm_params: Optional[GenericLiteLLMParams] )
methods.description: Extracts the input parameter from Litellm parameters for processing.

methods.name: str _get_initiator(self, input_param: Union[str, ResponseInputParam])
methods.description: Determines the X-Initiator header value ('agent' or 'user') based on input analysis.

methods.name: bool _has_vision_input(self, input_param: Union[str, ResponseInputParam])
methods.description: Checks if the input contains vision (image) content by recursively analyzing the input structure.

methods.name: bool _contains_vision_content( self, value: Any, depth: int = 0, max_depth: int = DEFAULT_MAX_RECURSE_DEPTH )
methods.description: Recursively searches for input_image type elements within nested input data.
